ROADMAP_ID=RM-05
PROPOSED_PHASE=P4_AUTHORIZED_PRODUCTION_DEPLOYMENT
PRIORITY=P1

GOAL
Provide an owner-authorized production path for promoting a previously verified external KIRARI Site artifact and restoring a known prior artifact.

SCOPE
Only after #98 staging evidence, define production authorization, credential separation, immutable Site-artifact promotion, deployed Core/Site/artifact provenance, health/smoke verification, failure recovery, and rollback to a prior retained Site artifact. Preserve the verified Vercel main-branch Git guard.

OUT_OF_SCOPE
- Edge Gateway runtime deployment, Gateway secrets, and Gateway lifecycle. These require their own explicitly authorized future delivery scope after the adapter work.
- Production action in PR/CI preview jobs, bypass or redesign of the Vercel main Git guard, or deployment before the owner separately authorizes a concrete target and operation.

ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA
- Production is a separate explicit approval from build and staging.
- Production promotes the exact reviewed Site artifact; no rebuild can silently change its contents.
- Deployment records Core SHA, Site SHA, artifact digest, and target.
- A failed Site deploy can restore the last approved artifact and verifies the restored target.
- Main-head deployment guard remains in force.

DEPENDENCIES
RM-04 / Issue #98 staging proof; owner selects and approves the Site production platform, environment, and release authorization policy.

DELIVERY_EVIDENCE
Approved workflow/authorization evidence, Site deployment provenance, health/smoke result, and a reviewed rollback record (simulation or authorized execution).

SOURCE_ROADMAP
KIRARI_NEXT_SPEC.md §§1, 3, 5, 10; PR-1 guard scope in PR #94 and archived guard task; external Site product outcome. Edge Gateway production lifecycle is not included here.
title: [RM-05] Promote an approved external Site artifact with provenance and rollback
